summary: Library as three panes (categories | papers | selected paper) with the user's note first in the right pane, a PDF glyph and note mark per row, and a graph that always draws every paper (folding is sidebar-only, no 60-paper gate, no leaf chevrons, no empty hint pill). The organization snapshot gains a derived per-paper pdf state (local/direct/page/none).
scope_note: Worktree library-zotero from main ef6e8bd. Existing tests that encoded the old behaviour (folded categories hiding graph papers, leaf chevrons, row detail button, row tags, open abstract) were updated; each is listed in the evidence file.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation and local reads only: the pdf state is derived from the pdfs table, an existing file check and stored open-access metadata. No model call, network request, prompt or stored-data change; AI 速览 is read from the already stored summary exactly as before.
budget_impact.before: library rows had no PDF indicator; notes only in a drawer opened by a button; graph hid folded papers and drew nothing above 60 papers
budget_impact.after: same data, shown differently; the snapshot carries one derived field per paper (a file-exists check per archived PDF)

additional_checks.scope: # 0 of 1132 (every interface string has an English entry)

open_risks: No browser check was done: three-column widths, narrow-window stacking, dark/light PDF glyphs and the hover command overlay are untested visually.
Large-library graph performance is bounded by a category line cap (tested as an edge count) but no frame rate was measured.
The right pane no longer shows arXiv id, DOI or work type text (the open-paper link remains).
Four now-unused English entries were removed from en-US.json together with the 60-paper overview gate.
